listing.name: Show Fleet DP
listing.summary: For all the times you underestimated that modded bounty. Shows enemy's fleet DP and effective strength (how strong it is in autoresolve)
listing.aiSummary: Shows enemy fleet deployment points and effective strength during autoresolve.

description: Displays the enemy's total deployment points and their effective strength as calculated by the autoresolve system. This helps players gauge the true power of modded bounties or other fleets before engaging.
